flags.claim: POL-NS-09(d) is triggered on the face of this record: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d stands at 3 for the trailing 30 days and that limb escalates the case at 3 or more. I rely on the trailing-window counter the limb actually names — POL-GEN-01 permits rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d to be cited for POL-NS-09(d) and for nothing else — and not on the lifetime prior_no_show_flags figure on the same profile, which is a different field and is not what the limb reads. Escalation under POL-NS-09 is mandatory and terminal under POL-GEN-03: the Judge issues no monetary ruling, the disputed SGD 4.50 is placed on hold rather than collected, and the rider therefore does not carry the disputed charge while a human reviewer settles the open question. The consequence is not academic here, because SGD 4.50 sits below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05 — a merits ruling against the rider would execute against her card on issue, whereas the escalation keeps the money held.

ledger.claim: The driver had actual notice that the rider was on her way down and did not answer her. The chat log records the rider's message 'coming down now' sent at 11:19:39 and read by the driver at 11:20:09, and before cancelling at 11:24:09 the driver neither posted a reply within 120 seconds of that message nor placed any in-app voice call — trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) are engaged on those facts. I do not press limb (c) as satisfied, because on this record it is not: the rider's own track places her device between 697 m and 704 m from the pickup pin across 69 fixes, with rider_qualifying_fix_count of 0 against the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider here and I do not ask the Judge to decide the fee under it.

I do not ask for a refund under POL-NS-06, and I say so rather than dress the numbers up: the driver's own trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius in a continuous run of 42 qualifying fixes running from 11:17:19 to 11:24:09, a dwell of 410 seconds against the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), so there is no shortfall in seconds and the arithmetic route to a full refund is closed on this record. What the record does carry is the POL-NS-09(d) counter, and what the rider seeks is that the disputed SGD 4.50 be reviewed by a person before it is taken — not that the fee was never chargeable in the ordinary course.

The trip record contains the driver's own 'arrived' event for this trip: at 2026-08-09T11:17:19+08:00 the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at the pickup point (event_type driver_arrived, source PLATFORM_TELEMETRY), so limb (a) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the platform's own record.

The driver was inside the arrival radius. The derived driver track puts his closest approach to the pickup pin at 0.111 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m), and the derived arrival facts record 42 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius in a single in-geofence run whose first fix is timestamped 11:17:19 — the same second as the recorded arrival event, with dwell_start_offset_sec of 0.0. The proximity test of POL-NS-02 is met and the in-geofence clock starts at 11:17:19, not later.

The driver held position inside the geofence for one continuous run of 410 seconds, from 11:17:19 to 11:24:09, on 42 fixes (derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run). The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180) and no_show_threshold_sec is null, so the limb (c) minimum is 180 seconds and the driver exceeded it by 230 seconds.

The termination satisfies limb (d). The trip record shows no boarding event and no trip start, and the trip was ended by the driver at 11:24:09 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the codes POL-NS-01(d) names — 230 seconds after the required 180-second dwell had elapsed at 11:20:19.

POL-NS-05 does not apply. The arrival marker is not false: the driver's closest approach to the pin is 0.111 m, and the derived arrival facts run the free-wait clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 11:17:19, the same timestamp as the marker. Nothing in the trace places the driver more than 300 m from the pin at the arrival timestamp, and a run of 42 consecutive in-geofence fixes spanning 410 seconds at a 10 second cadence is not a driver travelling at 15 km/h or more at the marker. No recomputation of the waiting clock is required, so the 410-second dwell stands as computed.

This is not a wrong-entrance case under POL-NS-03. That clause opens only where the driver's stationary fixes lie outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin; here they lie inside the radius, at a closest approach of 0.111 m, so POL-NS-02 governs and no refund route opens under POL-NS-03. In any event trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, so the pin-ambiguity limb of POL-NS-03 has nothing to operate on.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, because limb (c) is affirmatively failed. Even assuming the rider's 11:19:39 message 'coming down now' is a locating or coordinating message under limb (a) and that the driver's silence engages limb (b), the rider's own track carries 69 fixes from 11:15:33 to 11:25:48 whose closest approach to the pickup pin is 697.09 m — nearly seven times the 100 m rider-presence radius for STANDARD — and derived.arrival.rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0, so there is not one qualifying rider fix inside that radius across the waiting window. All three limbs are required; limb (c) fails on admissible fixes and the dispute is decided under POL-NS-01.

POL-NS-06's refund route does not open: the effective in-geofence dwell of 410 seconds exceeds the 180-second minimum on a single uninterrupted run, so there is no shortfall — the derived shortfall is -230 seconds. The accumulation limb POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable on this record and the driver says so plainly: the traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-03306-01 is MISSING, its admissibility status is MISSING, its weight_multiplier is 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT fired (no advisory covers Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd in this window); the trace also shows only one in-geofence interval, so there is no second interval to sum. The driver does not need that limb, because one continuous qualifying run already meets the minimum.

The rider's own account is contradicted by the record. The driver messaged 'hi im at the pickup point, where are you' at 11:17:44, the rider read it at 11:18:24 and answered 'coming down now' at 11:19:39, and the driver then waited a further 4 minutes 30 seconds — past the 11:20:19 expiry of the free waiting period — before terminating at 11:24:09. Throughout the window the rider's device never came closer than 697.09 m to the pickup pin, so 'I came down and the car was gone' is not consistent with the rider's own GPS track.

No integrity defect under POL-NS-08 undermines the driver's case. The chat log holds exactly the 2 messages trip_record.chat_message_count records, with the msg_id sequence intact and no gap spanning the arrival marker; the trace has 100.0% coverage at a 10 second cadence with max_gap_sec 0.0 and no sampling gap inside the waiting window; the arrival event and the first qualifying in-geofence fix share the same timestamp, i.e. 0 seconds of skew against the 90 second limb (a) threshold; and the SGD 4.50 cancellation-fee line reconciles exactly with the net fee in force, so limb (d) is not engaged.

The driver is entitled to compensation. With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force — SGD 3.60, which is the figure the fare ledger itself computes as driver_compensation. The anti-farming check trips on neither limb: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, below the 4-or-more limb, and 0 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d (60) is 0.0, below the 0.08 rate limb. No other driver_profile field is relied on for this check.

The fee is not refunded to the rider and the ruling the case produces is DRIVER_COMPENSATION. The fare ledger shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so on this rider-filed dispute the disposition of the fee is NO_ACTION and the charge stands; and because POL-NS-01 is satisfied and POL-NS-07 is engaged, the outcome is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 3.60 under POL-GEN-03.

One escalation limb is engaged and the driver states it rather than leaves it to be found: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 3, and POL-NS-09(d) is the limb that reads that trailing-30-day counter — not the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter, which POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting for it. On that limb the case routes to human review and the disputed SGD 4.50 is held rather than collected or refunded, which freezes the driver's position rather than reversing it; the driver asks that the completed POL-NS-01 findings and the SGD 3.60 POL-NS-07 entitlement travel in the escalation packet so the reviewer can release the fee and the compensation to him.

ruling.explanation:
Escalated to a human reviewer; the disputed SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is held — not collected from the rider, not released — until that review.

TRIGGER. POL-NS-09(d) requires escalation where rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 3 or more. The rider's profile (EV-RPROF-03306) shows exactly 3 no-show disputes in the trailing 30 days, so the case goes to a person, and POL-GEN-03 makes that terminal: no money moves now. POL-GEN-01 permits this field to be cited for this limb and nothing else; the lifetime prior_no_show_flags figure (also 3) is NOT the field the limb reads and was not used by either side.

DRIVER'S CASE, RECORDED FOR THE REVIEWER. The trip record (EV-TRIP-03306) carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 11:17:19; the GPS trace (EV-GPS-03306) places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius in one continuous run of 42 qualifying fixes from 11:17:19 to 11:24:09 — a dwell of 410 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force (platform_policy.free_wait_sec) — and the trip was ended by the driver at 11:24:09 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. On these artifacts POL-NS-01 limbs (a)–(d) read as satisfied and POL-NS-07 would pay the driver 80% of SGD 4.50 = SGD 3.60. His anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d = 0 against completed_trips_30d = 60). POL-NS-05 does not apply — the arrival marker is not false (closest approach 0.111 m; no 15 km/h motion at the marker) — and POL-NS-06's shortfall route does not open (shortfall −230 s). His claim that the emitted ruling should be DRIVER_COMPENSATION is therefore displaced by the mandatory escalation. His request that the packet DIRECT release of the SGD 4.50 and the SGD 3.60 is not something any clause authorises, so it is not issued as a referral; it is recorded here instead.

RIDER'S CASE, RECORDED FOR THE REVIEWER. POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) are engaged — the rider sent 'coming down now' at 11:19:39 and the driver neither replied within 120 s nor placed an in-app call — but limb (c) fails, because her own device stayed 697–704 m from the pin with rider_qualifying_fix_count of 0, so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate her. Her own submission concedes that limb, and the POL-NS-06 refund arithmetic is likewise closed. Her claim that the case must escalate under POL-NS-09(d) is accepted and is the ground of this ruling.

OPEN QUESTION FOR THE REVIEWER. Whether the three no-show disputes in the rider's trailing 30 days indicate abuse of the no-show process on her side (the limb's own basis for escalation), and, in light of that, whether the SGD 4.50 charge should stand and whether the driver's SGD 3.60 compensation should be released.

REFERRALS. None is issued: POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire (the arrival marker is not false), POL-NS-07's anti-farming direction to the packet does not fire, and no other clause produces a referral.

CONFIDENCE 0.90 — the escalating fact rests on EV-RPROF-03306, weight multiplier 1.0, which sets the POL-GEN-02(2) cap.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
